auth.description: Anthropic API key, sent as x-api-key
auth.name: anthropic.api_key
auth.subject: unstated

auth.description: Anthropic Admin API key (starts sk-ant-admin), sent as x-api-key. Required only for the Admin API operations below — organization, members, workspaces, workspace members, API keys and invites — the model catalogue uses the regular API key
auth.name: anthropic.admin_key
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: Create a key in the Anthropic Console (console.anthropic.com), under API Keys. This is the standard key used for the model catalogue
config.label: API key
config.name: api_key

config.help: Create an Admin API key in the Anthropic Console — only an organization member with the admin role can provision one. Required only for the Admin API operations, which read organization info, members, workspaces, workspace members, API keys and invites; the model catalogue works with the API key above alone
config.label: Admin API key
config.name: admin_key

description: Anthropic platform: the live model catalogue, and organization info, members, workspaces, workspace members, API keys and outstanding invites from the Admin API — all read-only

operations.description: List the models available to this API key, most recently released first. Unpaginated — this connector cannot request a further page

data.description: One entry per model this key can reach. Each carries at least `id` (the string to pass as `model_id` to anthropic-model-get, e.g. `claude-opus-4-6`), `type: "model"`, `display_name`, `created_at`, `max_input_tokens`, `max_tokens`, and a `capabilities` object describing which features (batch, citations, code execution, image/PDF input, structured outputs, extended thinking) this model supports

first_id.description: First id in `data`. This connector cannot use it as `before_id` — no query parameter is encodable (C-30)

has_more.description: True when the account has more models than this unpaginated call returned

last_id.description: Last id in `data`, likewise unusable as `after_id` here

operations.description: Retrieve one model by id, or resolve an alias to the model id it currently points at

params.description: The model id or alias, e.g. `claude-opus-4-6` or `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022`
params.name: model_id

capabilities.description: Which features this model supports — batch, citations, code execution, image/PDF input, structured outputs, extended thinking. See anthropic-models-list for why this is described rather than enumerated

created_at.description: When the model was released. May be an epoch value if the vendor does not know the release date

id.description: The model id, echoed back — or the id the alias resolved to

max_tokens.description: The maximum value this model accepts for a completion's own max_tokens parameter

operations.description: Get the organization this Admin API key belongs to. Takes no parameters; useful for confirming which organization a key resolves to

List the people in this organization, with each member's name, email address, organization role and the date they joined. Returns personal data about real individuals. Unpaginated — this connector cannot request a further page, so on an organization larger than one page this is a sample and not a roster

data.description: One entry per member of the organization

added_at.description: When the member joined the organization

email.description: The member's email address. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

id.description: The member's stable user id, and what anthropic-organization-member-get and anthropic-workspace-member-get address them by. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

name.description: The member's name as Anthropic holds it. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

role.description: The member's organization role — one of admin, billing, claude_code_user, developer, managed, membership_admin, owner, primary_owner, user. An open set in practice: Anthropic has added to it and this connector does not constrain the value

first_id.description: First id in `data`. This connector cannot use it as `before_id` — no query parameter is encodable (C-30)

has_more.description: True when the organization has more members than this unpaginated call returned

last_id.description: Last id in `data`, likewise unusable as `after_id` here

operations.description: Retrieve one organization member by user id, returning their name, email address, organization role and join date. Returns personal data about a real individual

params.description: The member's user id, as returned in `id` by anthropic-organization-members-list or in `user_id` by anthropic-workspace-members-list
params.name: user_id

added_at.description: When the member joined the organization

email.description: The member's email address. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

id.description: The user id, echoed back. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

name.description: The member's name as Anthropic holds it. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

role.description: The member's organization role — one of admin, billing, claude_code_user, developer, managed, membership_admin, owner, primary_owner, user. An open set in practice; this connector does not constrain the value

operations.description: List the organization's workspaces. Unpaginated and excludes archived workspaces by default — this connector cannot request a further page or ask for archived ones

data.description: One entry per workspace: `id`, `name`, `type: "workspace"`, `created_at`, `archived_at` (absent unless the workspace is archived), plus `data_residency` and user-defined `tags` objects

first_id.description: First id in `data`. This connector cannot use it as `before_id` — no query parameter is encodable (C-30)

has_more.description: True when the organization has more workspaces than this unpaginated call returned

last_id.description: Last id in `data`, likewise unusable as `after_id` here

operations.description: Retrieve one workspace by id, including its name, creation date, whether it is archived, and its data-residency configuration. Unlike anthropic-workspaces-list this reaches an archived workspace, since the id is given rather than filtered for

params.description: The workspace id, as returned in `id` by anthropic-workspaces-list
params.name: workspace_id

archived_at.description: When the workspace was archived, or null if it is not archived

compartment_id.description: This workspace's encryption-compartment identifier, referenced in a customer-managed KMS key policy on AWS. An identifier, never key material

data_residency.description: Where this workspace's data is stored and which inference geos it permits

allowed_inference_geos.description: The permitted inference geos: either an array of geo names or the string `unrestricted`. Left untyped rather than given a type, because the vendor documents it as either shape and this file states only what it can name with confidence

default_inference_geo.description: The inference geo applied when a request names none

workspace_geo.description: The region this workspace's data is stored in. Immutable after creation

display_color.description: The hex colour the Anthropic Console shows this workspace in

external_key_id.description: The customer-managed encryption key configuration attached to this workspace, when one is. An identifier, never key material

tags.description: User-defined string key-value tags on the workspace. Keys may not begin with `anthropic`. Left otherwise untyped — the keys are the operator's own

operations.description: List who belongs to one workspace and the role each holds in it. Returns the user ids of real individuals; resolve one to a name and email with anthropic-organization-member-get. Unpaginated — this connector cannot request a further page, so on a workspace larger than one page this is a sample and not a roster

params.description: The workspace id, as returned in `id` by anthropic-workspaces-list
params.name: workspace_id

data.description: One entry per member of the workspace

user_id.description: The member's organization-wide user id, and what anthropic-organization-member-get resolves to a name and email address. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

workspace_id.description: The workspace this membership is in — the same id that was passed in

workspace_role.description: The member's role in this workspace — one of workspace_admin, workspace_billing, workspace_developer, workspace_restricted_developer, workspace_user. Distinct from the organization-wide `role` on anthropic-organization-members-list

first_id.description: First id in `data`. This connector cannot use it as `before_id` — no query parameter is encodable (C-30)

has_more.description: True when the workspace has more members than this unpaginated call returned

last_id.description: Last id in `data`, likewise unusable as `after_id` here

operations.description: Retrieve one person's membership of one workspace, and the role they hold in it. This is the direct answer to whether a given user is in a given workspace; it returns the user id of a real individual

params.description: The workspace id, as returned in `id` by anthropic-workspaces-list
params.name: workspace_id

params.description: The member's user id, as returned in `id` by anthropic-organization-members-list
params.name: user_id

user_id.description: The member's organization-wide user id, echoed back. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

workspace_id.description: The workspace this membership is in — the same id that was passed in

workspace_role.description: The member's role in this workspace — one of workspace_admin, workspace_billing, workspace_developer, workspace_restricted_developer, workspace_user

operations.description: List the organization's API keys, with each key's name, status and a redacted hint — never the key itself. Unpaginated and unfiltered

data.description: One entry per API key: `id`, `name`, `status` (`active`, `inactive`, `archived` or `expired`), `type: "api_key"`, `created_at`, `expires_at` (absent for a key that never expires), `partial_key_hint` (a partially redacted display string, safe to show in a UI — never the key), `workspace_id` (absent for a key on the default workspace), and `created_by`/`principal` objects each `{id, type}`

status.description: One of active, inactive, archived, expired

first_id.description: First id in `data`. This connector cannot use it as `before_id` — no query parameter is encodable (C-30)

last_id.description: Last id in `data`, likewise unusable as `after_id` here

operations.description: List the organization's invites, with the email address invited, the role offered, and whether the invite is still pending. Returns personal data — an email address for a real person. Unpaginated and unfiltered by status, so a `pending` invite must be selected from the returned entries rather than asked for

data.description: One entry per invite, in whatever status the vendor holds it

accepted_at.description: When the invite was accepted, or null if it has not been

email.description: The email address the invitation was sent to. Identifies a named person — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

id.description: The invite's own id — an identifier for the invitation, not for the person

rbac_group_ids.description: RBAC group ids to assign on acceptance, `[]` when none. A Claude Enterprise beta field; present but empty on organizations not using it

role.description: The organization role the invitee is offered — one of admin, billing, claude_code_user, developer, managed, membership_admin, owner, primary_owner, user

status.description: One of accepted, deleted, expired, pending. This call cannot filter on it

first_id.description: First id in `data`. This connector cannot use it as `before_id` — no query parameter is encodable (C-30)

has_more.description: True when the organization has more invites than this unpaginated call returned

last_id.description: Last id in `data`, likewise unusable as `after_id` here

services.description: The live model catalogue: list available models, and retrieve one by id
services.name: models

services.description: Admin API: organization info and members, workspaces and their members, API keys, and outstanding invites — read-only
services.name: admin
